title: The NIN-like protein 5 (ZmNLP5) transcription factor is involved in modulating the nitrogen response in maize
genotypes: W22 (WT); zmnlp5 UniformMu insertion mutant UFMu-01175 (W22 background)
stage_age: V3 seedlings (7 d on sufficient N, 14 d N deprivation, then 30 min treatment)
N_treatments: N-starved seedlings resupplied with 15 mM KNO3 (+N) vs 15 mM KCl (-N control); pre-culture SN = 15 mM KNO3
platform_layout: Illumina (Berry Genomics, Beijing); instrument and read layout NR
other_omics: qPCR; ChIP-qPCR; dual-luciferase assay; nitrate/nitrite/ammonium contents; GRN from public 503-line pan-transcriptome
key_finding: Loss of ZmNLP5 blunts nitrate-responsive gene induction; ZmNLP5 binds NREs and activates ZmNIR1.1
notes: Gene-function paper (abstract does not mention RNA-seq); RNA-seq tissue described only as 'seedlings'; FPKM via Cufflinks

title: Natural variation in ZmNRT2.5 modulates husk leaf width and promotes seed protein content in maize
genotypes: ND101 (WT); zmnrt2.5 CRISPR/Cas9 1-bp deletion knockout (ND101 background)
tissue: young ears (~5.0 cm long; used to assess husk-leaf expression)
growth_system: greenhouse (N applied per area; substrate NR)
N_treatments: LN 1 kg N/100 m2 vs HN 2 kg N/100 m2 for the whole growth period (N form NR)
bio_reps: 3 (nine ears per genotype pooled into three replicates)
other_omics: RT-qPCR; husk and grain nitrate contents; GWAS (508 inbreds); protein-interaction assays
key_finding: ZmNRT2.5 loss alters nitrate-transport and cell-morphogenesis genes under HN and LN; narrower husks, lower seed protein
notes: No data-availability statement or accession found in PMC text; N rates from Fig. 5 legend; field trials (Zhuozhou) used for phenotypes only

title: Nitrogen-dependent binding of the transcription factor PBF1 contributes to the balance of protein and carbohydrate storage in maize endosperm
genotypes: B73 (SN vs DN RNA-seq); KN5585 (WT) and pbf1 CRISPR/Cas9 mutant in KN5585 background (RNA-seq under SN only)
growth_system: field, Luhe Experimental Station, Nanjing, China (N-deficient soil, 0.76 g N/kg); year NR
N_treatments: DN 0 kg N/ha vs SN 240 kg N/ha as ammonium sulfate (split 70/100/70 kg N/ha)
n_libraries: 6 for B73 SN vs DN (computed: 2 x 3); pbf1 vs WT set additional (count NR)
other_omics: ChIP-seq (PBF1, SN and DN endosperm); starch/protein/zein contents; EMSA; RT-qPCR
key_finding: N deficiency alters 4,899 endosperm genes; PBF1 binding pattern, not abundance, shifts with N supply
notes: Mutant RNA-seq only under SN, so mutant x N not tested transcriptomically; ~47 M PE reads per sample; paper text calls the BioProjects 'GEO series'

title: The Maize ZmbHLH118 Transcription Factor Regulates Vacuolar Nitrate Loading by the NO3- Transporter ZmCLCa
N_treatments: LN 0.04 mM KNO3 vs NN 4 mM KNO3
platform_layout: Illumina NovaSeq (Novogene, Beijing); ~6 Gb clean data per sample; layout NR
other_omics: qRT-PCR; nitrate and N contents; CRISPR/EMS mutant phenotyping; field yield
key_finding: ZmbHLH118 represses ZmCLCa, limiting vacuolar nitrate loading; overexpression alters N-metabolism and anion-transport genes
notes: Gene-function paper (abstract does not mention RNA-seq); no accession or data statement found in PMC text

title: Gene expression through comparative transcriptome analysis unravels the molecular mechanisms of fertilizer-induced hormonal regulation and leaf senescence in maize for enhanced yield in semiarid regions
tissue: flag leaves (composite of >=6 plants per plot)
growth_system: field, long-term fertilization trial since 2012 (Rainfed Agricultural Experimental Station, Gansu Agricultural University, Gansu, NW China), sampled 2023; rainfed, plastic-mulched ridge-furrow
N_treatments: NA no fertilizer; CF 200 kg N/ha urea + 150 kg P2O5/ha; SC 3.03 t/ha organic fertilizer + 100 kg N/ha urea + 120 kg P2O5/ha; SM 6.06 t/ha organic fertilizer + 90 kg P2O5/ha; MS 28.5 t/ha maize straw + 36 kg P2O5/ha
other_factors: P and organic amendments co-vary with N (fertilizer regimes)
other_omics: MDA/H2O2 and antioxidant enzymes; leaf N and organic C; SPAD; yield; RT-qPCR
key_finding: Inorganic N+P fertilizer produced most leaf DEGs vs unfertilized; hormone, photosynthesis and senescence genes affected
notes: N supply confounded with P and organic inputs (regime comparison, not N-only); title/abstract say 'fertilizer' rather than nitrogen

title: Ustilago maydis Nit2 Regulates Nitrate Utilisation During Biotrophy and Affects Amino Acid Metabolism of Galls Under Nitrogen Depletion
genotypes: maize cv. Early Golden Bantam (host) infected with U. maydis FB1xFB2 (WT) or FB1 nit2-deletion x FB2 nit2-deletion
N_treatments: host fertilised days 7-14 after sowing with Hoagland 1N (16 mM NO3- + 1 mM NH4+) vs -N (no N); 3N used only for amino-acid profiling
other_factors: U. maydis infection (WT vs nit2 deletion)
platform_layout: RNA-seq by Novogene (UK); platform and layout NR
other_omics: RT-qPCR; free and protein-bound amino acids; fungal biomass qPCR
key_finding: Fungal Nit2 controls nitrate and amino-acid utilisation genes in galls of N-replete and N-depleted hosts
notes: Dual RNA-seq of infected galls focused on fungal genes; maize genes analysed but 'not shown'; low priority for host-expression queries

title: Multi-Omics Analysis Reveals the Transcriptional Regulatory Network of Maize Roots in Response to Nitrogen Availability
genotypes: B73 (multi-omics); network step used 158 inbred lines (listed in Table S1)
stage_age: seedlings germinated 2 d, then 7 d treatment (age in days NR)
growth_system: paper-roll culture in nutrient solution (1 L per tub, renewed every 2 d); facility and location NR
N_treatments: CK nutrient solution (includes 1.0 mM Ca(NO3)2; full N composition NR) vs LN (Ca(NO3)2 omitted, Ca balanced with CaCl2)
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2000 (RNA-seq), layout NR; Ribo-seq on HiSeq X10; ATAC-seq on HiSeq 4000
key_finding: Low N represses N-metabolism and phenylpropanoid genes at transcript and translation levels; under half overlap
notes: Not indexed in PubMed; Data Availability says data are within the article and supplementary files (no accession); origin of the 158-line expression data not stated on page

title: Comparative transcriptome analysis of different nitrogen responses in low-nitrogen sensitive and tolerant maize genotypes
genotypes: Ye478 (low-N sensitive); Qi319 (low-N tolerant); selected from 304 accessions screened in the field
N_treatments: normal N vs low N (concentrations and N form NR on publisher page)
n_libraries: 16 (as stated; leaf and root of both genotypes)
platform_layout: RNA-seq ('high-throughput sequencing'); platform and layout NR
other_omics: differentially expressed miRNAs reported (15; method NR)
key_finding: Tolerant Qi319 roots up-regulate energy metabolism; sensitive Ye478 represses photosynthesis genes; ZmNLP5 implicated
notes: Not indexed in PubMed; open access; 16 libraries over 8 genotype x tissue x N groups implies 2 reps but not stated; authors Du QG, Yang J, Shah SMS, Yang RX, Yu JJ, Li WX

title: Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals the landscape of maize root tips and assists in identification of cell type-specific nitrate-response genes
growth_system: seedlings grown on media with or without nitrate (system NR)
key_finding: 11 root-tip cell types; 85 cell type-specific nitrate-response genes; root hairs derive from an epidermal subset
notes: Not indexed in PubMed; only abstract accessible; authors Li X, Zhang X, Gao S, Cui F, Chen W, Fan L, Qi Y
